visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a brown headband and a purple-and-white vertical striped short-sleeved shirt stands in a wide, paved urban square. She holds the camera in a selfie perspective, speaking directly with animated facial expressions and moving her hands to emphasize her points. The background features modern high-rise buildings, green trees, and a clear blue sky with soft white clouds. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit restaurant interior where the woman is now seated. She uses metal tongs to hold up a large, rectangular slice of raw Wagyu beef with intricate white marbling against a red meat base. A large black and white logo with Chinese characters for '和牛涮' is visible on the wall behind her. (3) A series of rapid insert shots display multiple black and red trays filled with thinly sliced raw beef on a light-colored wooden table. The woman is then shown using chopsticks to pick up a piece of cooked meat, dipping it into a small bowl of raw egg yolk, and placing it into her mouth with a satisfied and surprised facial expression. (4) The camera pans across a wide vegetable buffet counter featuring various greens, mushrooms, and corn under bright, warm lighting. This is followed by a top-down close-up of a black cast iron pot where white sugar is being sprinkled from a shaker, followed by sliced leeks, onions, and finally a slice of meat being seared in a dark sauce. (5) The woman holds up a bowl of dark beef curry and then a Taiyaki-shaped waffle cone topped with a swirl of vanilla and chocolate soft-serve ice cream. She smiles broadly, looking directly into the lens. The background shows wooden textures and hanging lanterns. (6) A promotional segment shows the woman placing her face behind a large cardboard cutout shaped like a slice of Wagyu beef with text. She then holds a real, large slice of raw beef in front of her face to show that the meat is larger than her head, widening her eyes in a comical expression of disbelief.
